# Vendored dependencies

| Dependency | Version | Source | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| MinHook | 1.3.4 | [TsudaKageyu/minhook](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4) | Hooking implementation and x64 instruction decoder |
| Node.js | 24.15.0 | [nodejs/node](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/v24.15.0/src) | Four Node-API headers |

Both dependencies retain their upstream license files. The build stages these licenses beside the native addon.
